pricing.heading: Model pricing
pricing.effectiveNone: No pricing — every campaign shows “cannot estimate cost”.
pricing.intro: Turns token budgets into dollar estimates for DMs. A model with no entry here shows an explicit “Campfire cannot estimate cost — monitor your provider’s billing” instead of a figure, which is the intended behaviour: a wrong number is worse than none. Prices are USD per million tokens.
pricing.endpointNote: Leave Base URL blank for the provider’s own endpoint. If a campaign points at a proxy or a self-hosted server, enter that URL explicitly — a model name behind a proxy does not imply the vendor’s price.
pricing.rowInput: Row {{n}} input price per million tokens
pricing.rowOutput: Row {{n}} output price per million tokens
pricing.prefillLabel: Provider to prefill reference prices for
pricing.errPrice: Row {{n}}: {{field}} price must be a number of dollars per million tokens (0 or more).
pricing.errTooMany: Too many entries: at most {{max}} model prices can be saved.
pricing.referenceAsOf: Campfire’s reference figures were last verified on {{date}}. They are a starting point, not a quote — vendors change prices without notice, so confirm them against your provider’s billing page before relying on the estimates.

catalog.title: Campaign catalog
catalog.subtitle: Every campaign on this server, as operational metadata only. Names and descriptions are privacy-gated, and no campaign content is shown or readable from here.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Name, description, rule system, or id
catalog.emptyHint: Clear a filter or widen the search to see more of the server.
catalog.tableCaption: Campaigns on this server with their operational metadata
catalog.redactedHint: This campaign withholds its name from the catalog. The placeholder is derived from its id only.
catalog.bulkHint: Preview with a dry run first. Each campaign is applied on its own, so a batch never half-applies — every item comes back with its own outcome.
catalog.dryRunSummary: Dry run: {{wouldApply}} would apply, {{skipped}} skipped, {{failed}} failed.
catalog.noOpHint: Nothing would change — the selected campaigns are already in this state.

op.request_export: Request an export from the DM

args.invitesCloseOnlyHint: The catalog can close public invites but not open them — a DM re-enables them on an active campaign from the campaign's own settings.
args.toUserIdRequired: Enter the user ID that should become the new owner.
args.quotaInvalid: Enter a whole number of bytes, or leave empty to clear the quota.
args.policyRequired: Choose at least one policy change.
args.ruleSystemRequired: Enter the rule pack slug to move these campaigns onto.
args.justificationRequired: An export request needs a justification of at least 10 characters — the DM reads it before deciding.

privacy.heading: Catalog privacy default
privacy.hint: What server admins may read about every campaign on this server. A campaign can always tighten this further; it can never loosen it.
privacy.sourceDefault: Currently the built-in default — no operator has configured this yet.
privacy.sourceSettings: Configured by an operator on this server.
privacy.tightenOnly: Saving stores both fields together, so the value you see here is the value that is stored. Campaigns that have opted out stay redacted either way.

catalog.previewStale: These values changed since the preview. Run the dry run again so Apply acts on what you were shown.

exportRequests.heading: Export requests
exportRequests.hint: Requests you or another operator raised through the campaign catalog, and how each campaign's DM answered. Approving records consent only — the export itself is still produced by the DM through the campaign's own export tools.
exportRequests.empty: No export requests have been raised yet.
